device: Smart Battery (SBDS v1.1) via Neware BTS
description: Smart Battery Data Specification v1.1 command set as polled by a Neware BTS cycler and Iontra DC_Daughter Card Address 0x10 (7-bit); SBDS standard is 0x0B — regenerate with --address if the pack moves. Sources: Neware-supplied register file Smart_Battery_Registers.txt [Neware], the user's Neware summary [user], SBDS v1.1 [SBDS]. The Neware file's default address is 0x0B; this capture's channel uses 0x10. Assumes CAPACITY_MODE = 0 (mAh/mA) and SpecificationInfo VScale = IPScale = 0; if either differs, capacity/current/voltage units are wrong. Words are little-endian (SMBus 3.3 §6.5.4-6.5.5). Writable: 0x00-0x04, plus 0x14/0x15 per the Neware file. Block reads 0x20-0x23 decode the length; text is in the ASCII column. Not decoded: 0x1D-0x1F (reserved), 0x2F/0x30-0x3B/0x40-0x4F manufacturer extensions, battery-to-charger broadcasts and AlarmWarning (Host Notify). Generated by build_neware_decoder.py.
byte_order_note: SMBus words: Data Byte Low first.
